explication: Impeccable is an AI-oriented frontend design skill and deterministic detector platform. An agent invokes the CLI, which routes commands, resolves project context, and either runs static HTML or browser/URL detection. Engines parse and inspect targets, apply shared rules, and return findings. Separate live-browser workflows support visual iteration, while the extension performs page snapshots and displays findings in DevTools. The tree also shows hooks, critique state, design-system checks, and skill packaging; some wiring is inferred only where module responsibilities are explicit.
